thread:
sophie: Quick heads-up — QuietCare cutover scheduled for next Tue 09:00 PT. Can owners confirm network + air-gap preflight items? I want a short checklist we can hand to customer ops by EOD Friday.

raj: On network side, I need confirmation of their egress proxy IPs and the CIDR for B2B tunnel. I sent an email but no response yet. Anyone with a direct contact? :telephone_receiver:

chris: I can grab the egress IPs from the provisioning request if we have the ticket id. Otherwise we need QuietCare to whitelist these ranges: 52.204.0.0/18, 13.32.0.0/14. Will verify exact NAT pairs.

marta: Platform checklist from our side: 
- preflight manifest applied (k8s configs)
- PV sizing validated
- image sync completed (airgapped)
- KMS access and certs in place
I can run the manifest validation and post the results.

tess: QuietCare told me their network lead is Anya (anya@quietcare.io). I cc'd her earlier, will ping again. They also said they'll be on standby during the window.

raj: Thanks @tess — can you ask Anya for the proxy IP and whether they have an egress timeout on the proxy? That can break long-lived streams.

marta: Small gotcha: our airgap image sync needs the customer to open outbound to our artifact mirror for the initial seeding. If they insist fully isolated, we need to do a bulk rsync over the jumpbox (we already have the script). Which do they prefer?

tess: Anya replied — they prefer jumpbox rsync. She asked for the rsync user and SSH fingerprint.

chris: RSYNC plan is fine. Marta, can you post the jumpbox user and fingerprint here? I'll coordinate with ops to schedule the transfer Thu night.

marta: Sure — user: redwood-sync, ssh-fp: SHA256:AbC123exampleFingerPrint. Also the rsync command we use: ```rsync -avz --progress --rsh='ssh -i /path/to/key' /local/images/ redwood-sync@jumpbox.quietcare:/incoming/```

sophie: Great. Ownership: 
- Network egress/NAT ranges: raj (blocker until QuietCare confirms)
- Airgap image transfer: marta (needs jumpbox creds from customer)
- KMS/certs + manifest validation: marta + chris pair
- Customer on-call + final whitelist: tess to own comms
Can everyone ack?

raj: Ack. I'll chase Anya now.

marta: Ack. Will validate manifests and post results by Fri 17:00 PT.

chris: Ack. I'll confirm NAT pairs and any port firewall rules we need (TCP 443, 5222 for tunnel, and 123 for NTP) and post the minimal rule set.

tess: Ack. I'll get jumpbox fingerprint verified and relay credentials.

deploy-bot: smoke-check scheduled for 2026-04-16T23:00Z. Results will be posted in this thread. :robot_face:

sophie: One more thing — can someone flag any rollout fallback we should prepare? If image transfer fails, we should have a plan to stall cutover and use hosted fallback for critical flows. Raj / Chris please add fallback network steps.

chris: Fallback: delay cutover, route critical traffic to hosted proxy pools (we have a preset route table). I'll draft a 5-step rollback plan and put it in the runbook.

raj: Also adding a network validation script we run from our side: ```curl -I https://metadata.redwood/services/health || echo network-fail``` — we can ask QuietCare to run a simple connectivity check before we flip.

sophie: Perfect. If no blockers surface by EOD Fri, we proceed with the Tuesday window. Thanks all — keep updates here so we have a single audit trail. :white_check_mark:
